title: 第3章 抓鱼第4章 吃鱼1
content_zh:
“恩！
空气这么清晰，果然跟21世纪工业化的污染空气不一样”
追梦深深的呼吸一口，有一种走进世外桃源的感觉。
放眼看去，眼前的都是木质的房子，房子有大有小，但都有一个共同的特点，房子都有用一颗颗圆木栅栏围起来的院墙。
熙熙攘攘，各家烟囱都还飘着清烟，有的还在做饭，有的烧水洗碗，有的在煮猪吃的猪食，有少数像追梦养母这样起来早的妇女，已经挑着衣服在代芳河边清洗，一片热闹而又淳朴的乡下生活景象。
此时的追梦记忆已经解封一部分，了知自己穿越前是21世纪一个42岁的老男人，有着成年人的思维智商，没有再去找这世界的小玩伴们玩耍，一个人静静的沿着代芳河岸走着，欣赏着一路的风景。
不知不觉来到一处河滩边，这里河滩很浅，水很清晰，能清晰的看到很多鱼儿游来游去，成群结队的，有大有小，非常喜人。
勾起了追梦穿越前儿时在稻田里抓鱼的乐趣，但想起出门时养母的吩咐，追梦内心又一阵犹豫。
可能是在这个世界12年的记忆作怪，追梦怕养母看到他不听她的嘱咐，怕养母伤心难受，所以才犹豫的。
但身为21世纪的穿越客，追梦是成年人，有自己的主见。
“没事的，我就在河边浅水区抓鱼，不去深处就行了。”
追梦决定下河抓一次鱼回家吃。
这条河的鱼好像没什么人抓，追梦走近看了半天也没见鱼儿被吓跑，直到追梦脱裤子下水，才有一部分鱼儿才懒散的游出了一点距离，但距离的没超过1米远。
一些大胆的鱼儿没游走，还在追梦脚上蹭来蹭去，让追梦体验到了穿越前用鱼儿足疗的感觉。
一时，追梦也不舍得下手破坏这一刻的美好。
追梦开始静静的享受起来。
追梦内心却在做思想斗争，在数着这条鱼大，那条鱼小。
“嗯！
这条鱼起码有五斤”
“不行，再等等，看还有没有大的！”

一会儿。
“嗯！
这条起码有十斤！”
“不等啦！
我决定要这条。”
“嗯！
那儿还有个更大的。”
追梦看到一条十斤的鱼，正准备抓，又看到后面游来了一条更大的，一时纠结如何选一条最好的，追梦知道自己下手的机会不多，鱼儿被惊慌后，想再把鱼儿吸引到自己身边来，是非常困难的。
“嗯！
这条鲤鱼可以，全身金黄金黄的！
煮着吃，味道应该很美！”
最后，追梦看到一条十来斤的黄金大鲤鱼，决定就抓这条黄金大鲤鱼。
追梦双手缓缓的伸向水中，鱼儿也不怕，还上前在追梦手上蹭来蹭去。
可是追梦的目标不是他们，双手小心而又缓慢绕过，摸向黄金大鲤鱼。
在追梦双手摸到黄金大鱼那一刻，黄金大鱼只是短暂的警惕了一下，见追梦只是摸了它一下，又没有伤到它，也没有抓它，也就任追梦摸。
content_en:
"Yeah!
The air is so clear, it is indeed different from the polluted air of industrialization in the 21st century.”
Zhui Meng took a deep breath, feeling like he had entered a paradise.
Looking around, the houses in front of us are all wooden houses. The houses are large and small, but they all have a common feature. The houses are all surrounded by courtyard walls made of log fences.
It was bustling with people, and clear smoke still floated from the chimneys of every house. Some were still cooking, some were boiling water for washing dishes, and some were cooking pig food for pigs. A few women like Zhui Meng's adoptive mother, who got up early, were already picking up clothes to wash by the Daifang River. It was a lively and simple rural life scene.
At this time, part of the dream-chasing memory has been unlocked, and I know that before I traveled through time, I was a 42-year-old man in the 21st century, with the thinking and IQ of an adult. He no longer went to play with the little playmates in this world, and walked quietly along the bank of the Daifang River alone, admiring the scenery along the way.
Unknowingly, we came to a river beach. The river beach here is very shallow and the water is very clear. You can clearly see many fish swimming around in groups, some big and some small, which is very gratifying.
It brought back the joy of catching fish in the rice fields as a child before Dream Chasing Time Travel, but remembering his adoptive mother's instructions when he went out, Chasing Dreams felt hesitant in his heart.
Maybe it was the memories of his 12 years in this world that caused trouble. Zhui Meng was afraid that his adoptive mother would see him disobeying her instructions, and he was afraid that his adoptive mother would be sad and uncomfortable, so he hesitated.
But as a time traveler in the 21st century, Chai Meng is an adult and has his own opinions.
"It's okay. I'll just catch fish in the shallow water of the river. I won't go to the deep water."
Zhui Meng decided to go down to the river to catch fish and take it home to eat.
It seemed that no one was catching fish in this river. Zhui Meng came closer and looked for a long time, but he didn't see any fish being scared away. It wasn't until Zhui Meng took off his pants and entered the water that some of the fish lazily swam a little distance away, but the distance was not more than 1 meter.
Some bold fish did not swim away, but still rubbed against Meng Zhui's feet, allowing Meng Zhui to experience the feeling of having a fish foot massage before traveling through time.
For a moment, Chai Meng was reluctant to destroy the beauty of this moment.
Chasing Dreams began to enjoy quietly.
Chai Meng was having an ideological struggle in his heart, counting which fish was bigger and which fish was smaller.
"Hmm!
This fish weighs at least five pounds.”
"No, wait a little longer and see if there are any bigger ones!"
a while.
"Hmm!
This one weighs at least ten pounds! "
"No wait!
I decided to get this one. "
"Hmm!
There's a bigger one over there. "
Zhui Meng saw a ten-pound fish and was about to catch it when he saw a bigger one swimming behind him. He was confused about how to choose the best one. Zhui Meng knew that he didn’t have many chances to catch the fish. After the fish was frightened, it was very difficult to attract the fish to him again.
"Hmm!
This carp is great, it’s golden all over!
Cook it and eat it, it should taste delicious! "
Finally, Zhui Meng saw a big golden carp weighing about ten pounds and decided to catch this big golden carp.
Zhui Meng slowly stretched his hands into the water. The fish was not afraid and even stepped forward to rub against Meng Zhui's hands.
But the target of the dream was not them. His hands carefully and slowly moved around and touched the golden carp.
The moment Zhui Meng touched the big golden fish with his hands, the big fish was only wary for a short time. Seeing that Zhui Meng only touched it once and didn't hurt it or catch it, it just let Zhui Meng touch it.
